I answered Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message. I said no action is needed on the Halyard rollout at Marrow Agrisupply, and asked him to clarify the date.

The date needs checking because it's 14 Oct 2026 in the simulation. A 6 June deadline has either already passed or he means 6 June 2027.

His message is the only mention of Halyard I can find. It doesn't appear anywhere else in #central-team, in the shared files or in the knowledge brain, so nothing confirms or contradicts the date.

Nothing else was needed: no finance figures, no mail and no approvals.
